Dear The Synergist Team,

I am writing to apply for the Junior Communications Manager position at The Synergist. With a background in digital marketing, web design, and project coordination, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to your mission of tackling global societal challenges through effective communication.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, content creation, and WordPress site maintenance for multiple clients. I am comfortable coordinating campaigns, tracking deadlines, and collaborating with cross-functional teams. My experience with tools like Asana, Google Workspace, WordPress, Canva, and Figma aligns well with your requirements. I am also proactive in following up with vendors and internal teams to ensure projects stay on track.

I am particularly drawn to The Synergist's focus on health equity and rare diseases, and I am eager to bring my organizational skills and tech-savviness to support your programs. I am fluent in English and Turkish, with a working knowledge of Dutch, and I am based in Belgium, ready for hybrid work.

I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to your team. Thank you for considering my application.

Best regards,

Baver Ok
+32 470 42 48 36
baverok@gmail.com
linkedin.com/in/baverok
cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am excited to apply for the Junior Communications Manager position at The Synergist. Your mission to tackle complex global issues like health equity and rare diseases through collaboration resonates deeply with me. As a junior digital marketer with a strong technical foundation and a passion for organization, I am confident in my ability to serve as the operational engine behind your communications team.

In my current role at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, write keyword-targeted content, and build and maintain WordPress sites for clients. This experience has honed my ability to coordinate multi-channel campaigns, manage assets, and keep projects moving on schedule. I am well-versed in tools like Asana, Google Workspace, WordPress, Canva, and Figma, and I quickly adapt to new platforms. My proactive 'chaser' mindset ensures that vendors and internal teams deliver on time, and I am comfortable escalating blockers before they stall progress.

One of my proudest achievements is my personal project, mirook.com, where I designed and built a WordPress site from scratch, implemented structured data for AI search visibility, and ran iterative SEO audits. This project demonstrates my ability to manage end-to-end production, from content creation to technical implementation, while maintaining a keen eye for detail.

I am particularly drawn to The Synergist's collaborative culture and the opportunity to work on meaningful initiatives. I am fluent in English and Turkish, with a working knowledge of Dutch, and I am based in Belgium, ready to embrace your hybrid work structure. I am eager to bring my organizational skills, tech agility, and enthusiasm to your team.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of contributing to your impactful work.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok

Baver Ok
Digital Marketing · Communications Coordination · Content · Web
Zwijndrecht, Belgium | +32 470 42 48 36 | baverok@gmail.com | linkedin.com/in/baverok

## Profile
Junior digital marketer with a technical foundation in web design, SEO, and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization). At Episto, I run on-page SEO, keyword-targeted content, and full-cycle WordPress site build and maintenance for client sites. On my own project (mirook.com) I've applied structured data, entity optimization, and technical SEO/GEO audits to improve visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. Comfortable across content management, social media coordination, and performance reporting; quick to pick up new tools and platforms, and growing into analytics, e-commerce content management, and campaign support. Based in Zwijndrecht, next to Antwerp. Works in English and Turkish; Dutch: B1, currently taking classes to improve further.

- Project Coordination: Asana, Google Workspace, deadline tracking, vendor follow-ups, asset organization
- Content & CMS: SEO blog & content writing, editorial content publishing, website content management, WordPress site building, Canva, Figma
- Web & build: WordPress, Elementor, Astra theme, responsive web design, AI-assisted content tools
- Analytics & reporting: Google Analytics, Google Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Ads
- Social: social media content & integration (LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook)
- Languages: English (professional), Turkish (native), Dutch (B1)
